Messages.Author: Terrence W Wright
Messages.Body:
Just a question for anyone who might know.
Can the "Sudden Reversal" card be played to burn a Master card as it is
being cast, or after it enters play.?


   The card text says "Burn a master card played by another Methuselah."
Now does that mean I can...
   A) Burn your Minion Tap as you try to cast it?
   B) Burn your Police Station after you have had it out for a number of turns.
   C) Both of the above.

  Our debate over the card is whether a card "...played..." is unique from a
card that "...is in play..." or not. 
  Thanx for your time.
